correctness.rationale: For K_{a,b} with a,b>=3 and t deleted independent cross edges, enumerated shortest paths by pair class: ab-t intact cross pairs contribute one; each removed x_i y_i has exactly (b-1)(a-1)-(t-1) length-three geodesics (choices of two middle indices except the t-1 blocked ones); left-internal pairs contribute b*C(a,2)-t(a-1), right-internal a*C(b,2)-t(b-1), and a+b vertex-length-zero paths are included by definition. Summation simplifies to a+b+ab(a+b)/2+t(ab-2a-2b+3)-t², for the whole connected family. Concavity of t(C-t) proves integer argmax nearest C/2 clipped to permitted interval. For a=b=n, direct substitution yields n=3 maximum t=0, n=4 tie t=1,2, n=5 t=4, and t=n for n>=6. The crown difference n(n²-5n+3) is positive n>=5. Independent BFS path-multiplicity computations corroborated 130 parameter cases (3<=a,b<=7), not used in place of the pairwise proof.
